data.long_meaning: The name Gigi is derived from the Italian word giove, meaning Jupiter. In Christianity, the name is a derivation of the Greek name for God, Ge, and the Latin name for God, Deus. The name Gigi symbolizes God's pledge or promise to its bearer. The name Gigi carries the meaning “God's pledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gigi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
